nodes.name: Daily Loss Cap OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-002) defining the Daily Loss Cap OK boolean condition: blocks new trading once realized daily P&L reaches or exceeds the configured loss cap, implemented as `daily_loss_cap_ok()` in the guardrail engine.

nodes.name: Duplicate OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-006) defining the Duplicate OK L3 idempotency guard: ensures a snapshot_id has not already produced a Gold DecisionPacket, preventing replay-induced duplicate decisions in the paper-trading runtime.

nodes.name: Max Positions OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-004) defining the Max Positions OK boolean condition: blocks new trades when the count of concurrently open positions reaches the configured maximum, bounding simultaneous exposure.

nodes.name: Max Trades OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-003) defining the Max Trades OK boolean condition: enforces the daily trade count cap (`MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY`) to prevent overtrading, implemented in the guardrail engine predicates module.

nodes.name: Operational OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-007) defining the Operational OK L3 runtime guard: verifies instrument tradability, venue openness, and absence of halts or degradation before acting on a Gold DecisionPacket, keeping operational state out of the deterministic snapshot-local decision core.

nodes.name: Position Size OK.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-001) defining the Position Size OK boolean condition: enforces that a proposed trade size does not exceed the lesser of a percentage-of-equity cap and an absolute dollar cap, implemented as a pure function in the guardrail engine.

nodes.name: Withdrawal Disabled.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph predicate node (PRED-005) defining the Withdrawal Disabled invariant: a fail-closed safety predicate that blocks all trades if withdrawals are ever enabled, enforcing that the autonomous agent can never initiate fund movement.
